question: Do I have to keep receipts for small purchases?
answer: Yes—every expense over 25 dollars needs a receipt, so expenses of 25 dollars or less do not require a receipt [1].
handbook_text: [Expenses > Receipts] Submit expense reports within 30 days of the trip. Every expense over 25 dollars needs a receipt.

question: What are the rules for booking flights?
answer: Flights must be booked through the company travel portal, and economy class is required for flights under 6 hours [1].
handbook_text: [Expenses > Travel] Book flights and hotels through the company travel portal. Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours.

question: After my parental leave, can I work from home and what do I need for that?
answer: After your parental leave, you may work remotely up to three days a week with manager approval [2]. Remote work requires a secure home network and a company laptop [2].
handbook_text: [Working hours > Remote work] Employees may work remotely up to three days a week with manager approval. Remote work needs a secure home network and a company laptop.

question: How many vacation days and how many sick days do I get?
answer: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid vacation each year [2]. Employees receive 10 paid sick days each year [1].
handbook_text:
[Time off > Vacation] Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid vacation each year. Unused vacation days carry over for up to 5 days into the next year. Contractors do not receive paid vacation.
[Time off > Sick leave] Employees receive 10 paid sick days each year. A doctor's note is required after 3 consecutive sick days.

question: Who keeps this handbook up to date?
answer: The People team updates this handbook each quarter [1].
handbook_text: [About this handbook] This handbook describes how Acme Robotics employees work. It is updated each quarter by the People team. Contractors are covered only where a section says so.

question: How long can maternity or paternity leave last?
answer: New parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave, which is the maximum duration stated [1].
handbook_text: [Time off > Parental leave] New parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave. The leave can start up to 2 weeks before the expected birth or adoption date.

question: Are two-factor logins mandatory?
answer: Multi-factor authentication is required for every administrator account, so two-factor logins are mandatory for administrators [1].
handbook_text: [Security > Passwords] Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. Multi-factor authentication is required for every administrator account.

question: Is alcohol covered when I travel for work?
answer: No—alcohol is not reimbursed during business travel [1].
handbook_text: [Expenses > Meals] Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to 60 dollars per day. Alcohol is not reimbursed.

question: I am leaving next month and have a company laptop. What do I need to do?
answer: When you leave the company, you must return your laptop within 5 business days and contact IT to arrange a courier [1]. Your access to company systems ends at the close of your last day [3].
handbook_text:
[Equipment > Returning equipment] When you leave the company you must return your laptop within 5 business days. Contact IT to arrange a courier.
[Leaving the company > Offboarding] Your last day is set with your manager and the People team. Your access to company systems ends at the close of your last day.
